workflow.name: A2A agent round trip
workflow.description: A2A in both directions, with no model keys. The Expose as A2A Agent trigger serves this workflow as an Agent2Agent agent (Agent Card at /a2a/a2a-round-trip/.well-known/agent-card.json, callers send an L2M API key). Each task it receives is passed to an A2A Agent node, which calls the built-in mock-a2a://echo test agent, and the echo comes back as the task's answer. Point the A2A Agent node at a real agent's card URL to delegate for real.

config.agentDescription: Passes each message to another A2A agent and answers with its reply.
